scope: All 658 files under design/** from the baseline commit. This lists repository assets and design authority files; it does not assert that every file is a canonical or approved asset.

verification_method.sha256: Recomputed only when raw file bytes were returned. SHA-256 fields are null where raw bytes were unavailable.
verification_method.git_blob_sha: Copied from baseline Git tree/blob metadata, separate from SHA-256.
verification_method.visual_review: Five static screenshots inspected: Empty Home, NH02 First Catch, My Catches, Record Date Month, Fish Guide. Not runtime parity.
verification_method.declaration_rule: Only explicit current-content hash fields bound to the exact repository path are treated as current declarations. Historical source, previous_repository, and supersedes hashes are excluded from current-asset identity.
verification_method.raw_sha256: Recomputed from raw bytes only. actual_sha256 is null where bytes were unavailable.
verification_method.raw_access_explanation: For BLOCKED_ACCESS rows, GitHub Contents API omitted large binary bytes. Repository path, size, and Git blob SHA remain recorded.
verification_method.license_scan: No license declaration found in scanned repository authorities; provenance evidence is recorded per row when explicit.
verification_method.worktree_integrity: The verifier compares every registered baseline file with its current checkout. Only explicit, content-addressed non-frozen worktree exceptions are allowed; frozen references cannot be allowlisted.
verification_method.baseline_blob_integrity: The verifier reads each file from baseline_commit_sha and independently recalculates size, Git blob SHA-1, and SHA-256.
